phase.$description: Time-of-day theme. Each file points at one phase set in the color files; the app picks the file for the current prayer period. Mode: Dhuhr.

top.$description: Top of the time-of-day sky gradient: hero, widgets, the Today background. Its value follows the frame Phase mode (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha, Neutral) and Color mode (Light, Dark).

bottom.$description: Bottom of the time-of-day sky gradient. Its value follows the frame Phase mode (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha, Neutral) and Color mode (Light, Dark).

tint.$description: Signature mark of the time of day: timeline segment, glyph, progress (3:1). Its value follows the frame Phase mode (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha, Neutral) and Color mode (Light, Dark).

text.$description: Text in the time-of-day color (4.5:1 on its sky and on cells). Its value follows the frame Phase mode (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha, Neutral) and Color mode (Light, Dark).

tint-subtle.$description: Quiet wash of the time of day, behind the next row. Its value follows the frame Phase mode (Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha, Neutral) and Color mode (Light, Dark).
